about.title: About me
about.p1: Senior Frontend Engineer with 7 years of experience building, modernizing, and supporting scalable web applications across financial services, healthcare, human resources, public services, and digital products. My core expertise includes React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Frontend Architecture, and Vue.js, complemented by professional experience with Angular and full-stack technologies.
about.p2: I have contributed to complex products from technical refinement and architecture decisions through implementation, automated testing, REST API integration, and production delivery. My experience includes Micro Frontends with Module Federation, reusable component architecture, Design Systems, Style Dictionary, Storybook, Jest, Vitest, Testing Library, Docker, and Nginx. These initiatives improved interface consistency, reduced regression risk, strengthened maintainability, and supported the continuous evolution of production applications.
about.p3: I work closely with Product, Design, Backend, and Quality Engineering teams to translate business requirements into reliable and maintainable technical solutions. My approach combines product ownership, architecture awareness, code review, performance, accessibility, testing, and continuous improvement, positioning me to contribute effectively to international and distributed product engineering teams.
